chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 82: Li Huowang Meets a Grotesque Abbess & Learns a Heart-Element's Fate
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang finds unsettling humor at a rundown nunnery, but his respite ends when he meets the blind, festering Abbess Jingxin, who reveals a terrifying truth about his condition as a Heart-Element.
og_description: A brief moment of peace shatters when Li Huowang meets a blind nun whose flesh writhes with sores—and who knows far too much about what he is.
twitter_title: Ch. 82: Li Huowang finds a hilarious, disgusting nunnery... then meets the Abbess.
twitter_description: The nuns of Anci Nunnery are crude and funny, but their Abbess is a blind mountain of festering flesh who casually reveals the tragic fate of all Heart-Elements.
